hypotheses.description: get_func_args_dict calls inspect.signature(func) without specifying annotation_format=inspect.Format.FORWARDREF. On Python 3.14, PEP 649 makes annotations lazy, so inspect.signature evaluates them eagerly by default, causing NameError when annotations reference names not in scope (e.g., scrapy.Request under TYPE_CHECKING). The fix is to pass annotation_format=inspect.Format.FORWARDREF to inspect.signature to defer evaluation.
